commands.review_summary:
The PR adds a dedicated private, SSM-only AWS workspace API, Node credential-chain support, fail-closed deployment guards, an ECS Fargate/ALB/IAM stack, tests, dependencies, and operational documentation.

Reproducibility: yes. for the compatibility defect: source inspection gives a high-confidence path where a Node deployment has a region variable but no credential-bearing source and still passes the automatic AWS probe gate. The complete AWS service lifecycle has not been reproduced.
